newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares extends gains, dollar supports.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares extends gains, dollar supports.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Belgian shares end firmer on Tuesday after a week of gains, once more outperforming neighbouring markets. Helped by partial dollar recovery and stronger start on Wall Street.
* Bull run seen continuing in the short term at least, underpinned by the prospect of dividend payouts though still considered vulnerable to any surprising U.S. economic data.
* Bel-20 index .BFX up 13.23 points or 0.61 percent at 2,196.43 with 2.5 billion francs worth of Belgian shares traded
* Shipper CMB among losers, down 1.52 percent after 1996 final earnings published at the weekend were worse than preliminary figures had suggested.
